em_pike_fetch: lying on a warm brick stove, lazily points a finger while a big grey pike in a wooden bucket beside him rears up holding a card-sized birch-bark scroll in its teeth.
em_sweet_nap: fast asleep on a warm brick stove under a sheepskin, mouth open, a contented smile, a cat curled on his belly.
em_oven_fork: @an iron oven fork (ukhvat) on a long wooden handle flying by itself through a dark peasant hut and jabbing at a shadowy creature, no one holding it.
em_poker: @a red-hot iron stove poker sweeping by itself through the air in a wide arc, scattering sparks of ash over a crowd of dark shapes, no one holding it.
em_sheepskin: wrapped up to the nose in a huge shaggy sheepskin coat on a stove, only his sleepy eyes and blond fringe showing, a claw scraping harmlessly at the fleece.
em_rolling_pin: @a heavy wooden rolling pin tumbling end over end by itself through a dim hut towards a creature, flour dust trailing, no one holding it.
em_stretch: sitting up on a stove in a long, enormous yawning stretch, arms raised high, shirt riding up, eyes squeezed shut.
em_firewood: @a woodshed in snow where an axe chops logs by itself and split firewood leaps into a neat stack, no one holding the axe.
em_kvass: lying on a stove, drinking kvass from a big wooden ladle, foam on his upper lip, eyes half closed with pleasure.
em_bream: lying on a stove, lazily slaps a snarling creature across the face with a big dried bream fish held by the tail.
em_pike_whisper: leaning down from a stove to whisper into the ear of a big grey pike in a wooden bucket, hand cupped to his mouth, the pike's eye gleaming.
em_seeds: lying on a stove, cracking sunflower seeds and spitting husks onto the floor, a heap of husks beside him, sleepy and content.
em_sleigh_train: @a long train of empty wooden sledges racing by themselves down a snowy village street with no horses, scattering dark creatures, the stove leading them.
em_samovar: @a big dented brass samovar on a table in a dark peasant hut, steam curling from it, a glass of tea in a holder and a saucer of jam beside it.
em_i_want: standing on a stove, raising a fist and shouting a wish, behind him a huge shadow of a pike looming over the whole hut.
em_stove_bench: sprawled on the wide sleeping ledge of a huge whitewashed brick stove, patchwork quilts and pillows piled under him, warm amber light.
em_pike_grip: @a huge grey pike bursting out of a black ice hole, its toothy jaws clamped on the leg of a dark creature, dragging it down.
em_sbiten: sitting on a stove, holding a steaming clay mug of hot honey sbiten with both hands, cheeks red, steam in his face.
em_sloth_friend: lying on a stove arm in arm with a fat grey shaggy sloth spirit, both of them asleep and snoring.
em_bucket_row: @a row of wooden water buckets marching by themselves in single file up a snowy path from a frozen river, water slopping, no one carrying them.
em_ice_fishing: sitting on an upturned bucket by a hole in river ice, holding a short fishing rod, yawning, wrapped in a sheepskin, snowy dusk.
em_half_awake: jerked half awake on a stove, one eye open, hair standing up, angrily flinging a felt boot at a creature.
em_fish_pie: sitting on a stove, biting into a huge golden fish pie (kulebyaka) held in both hands, crumbs on his shirt.
em_splash: @a whole bucket of icy river water flying out of a wooden bucket by itself and drenching a group of dark creatures, no one holding the bucket.
em_pike_to_work: lying on a stove, lazily waving his hand, while axes, buckets and oven forks rush past him by themselves towards the enemy.
em_mother_pike: @an enormous ancient grey pike with a scarred body and a tiny gold crown, rising out of a black river under the ice, looking straight at the viewer.
em_sleepy_kingdom: @a whole snowy village and its creatures fallen asleep where they stand, snow settling on them, a heavy grey mist creeping over everything.
em_bear_sleep: asleep in a snowy den beside a sleeping brown bear, both snoring under a blanket of snow, frost on his eyelashes.
em_stove_ram: riding a huge brick stove on sledge runners that smashes straight through a log wall, bricks and timber flying, his face sleepy and calm.
em_golden_pike: lying on a stove, holding up a small shining golden pike in both hands, its scales catching the candlelight, wide-eyed in wonder.
em_dream_come_true: asleep on a stove, and above him a dreamlike ghostly image of himself in a tsar's red kaftan, the two overlapping.
em_all_by_itself: @a peasant hut where everything works by itself: a broom sweeping, a spindle spinning, a pot stirring, a log jumping into the stove, no one there.
em_feast: sitting at the head of a long table heaped with pies, roast goose, pancakes and jugs of mead, cheeks puffed, both hands full.
em_pike_order: standing on a stove pointing forward like a commander, a huge grey pike rising behind him and a swarm of flying axes and buckets charging ahead.
em_snowdrift: bursting up out of a deep snowdrift, snow sliding off his shoulders, hair full of snow, sleepy and furious, icicles hanging from his sleeves.
